evals.prompt: Publish a sprint report for Sprint 14 of TaskFlow. 34/40 points completed, goal achieved, 2 items carried over.
evals.expected_output: Gathers cycle data, renders the sprint-report HTML template, calls page(action=create, project_id, ...), returns the URL.
expectations: Consults connector-bootstrap
Uses the sprint-report HTML template from references/templates/sprint-report.html
Populates Summary, Delivered, Not Delivered, Metrics, Next Sprint sections
Calls page(action=create) with project_id, name and valid description_html

evals.prompt: Create a retrospective page for the sprint we just closed. Include previous action items status.
evals.expected_output: Uses the retro template, fetches previous retro page, renders both previous action item statuses and new action items.
expectations: Uses the retro HTML template
Checks for and loads a previous retro page if one exists
Renders Previous Action Items with status (done, in progress, carried over)
Includes What Went Well / What Didn't / Action Items sections with owners and due dates

evals.prompt: Publish customer-facing release notes for v2.0.
evals.expected_output: Uses release-notes template, curates items (omits internal work), groups by category.
expectations: Uses the release-notes HTML template
Curates items for a customer audience (omits internal/dev items)
Groups by Highlights, New Features, Improvements, Bug Fixes, Breaking Changes
Does not include PII or secrets

evals.prompt: Publish a Q2 roadmap page showing Now / Next / Later / Parked.
evals.expected_output: Uses the roadmap template, aggregates cycles/modules/epics/milestones into the four buckets, calls page(action=create).
expectations: Uses the roadmap HTML template from references/templates/roadmap.html
Classifies items into Now / Next / Later / Parked buckets correctly
Pulls data from cycle(action=list), module(action=list), an epic listing through workitem(action=list, pql='type = "<epic-type-id>"') (there is no epic tool), milestone(action=list)
Calls page(action=create) with the rendered HTML

evals.prompt: Publish a milestone update for 'v2.0 Public Beta'. Target Apr 30, 34/52 points done, weekly velocity 8.
evals.expected_output: Uses the milestone-update template, computes ETA and risk, renders On Track / At Risk / Blocked sections.
expectations: Uses the milestone-update HTML template
Computes remaining points, ETA, and risk level (Red/Yellow/Green)
Renders On Track, At Risk, Blocked sections
Calls page(action=create) with the rendered HTML

evals.prompt: The Sprint 14 report page we published yesterday has a wrong velocity number (it says 34, should be 31). Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Agent updates the existing page in place instead of creating a duplicate or telling the user to edit it in the web UI: retrieves the page, corrects the number in the full HTML body, and calls page(action=update) with the whole description_html.
expectations: Does not claim that pages are write-once or that the user must edit the page in the Plane web UI (the page tool supports update)
Retrieves the page first with page(action=retrieve)
Calls page(action=update) with the complete edited description_html, not a fragment, because update replaces the whole body
Does not create a second page for the same report

evals.prompt: Delete the test page 'Sandbox sprint report' from the Sandbox project.
evals.expected_output: Agent knows delete needs an archived page and the user's confirmation: shows the page, asks for explicit confirmation, archives it, then deletes it.
expectations: Identifies the page and shows it to the user before deleting
Asks for explicit confirmation before the delete (destructive action)
Calls page(action=archive) before page(action=delete), because delete is refused for a page that is not archived
Does not say that pages cannot be deleted through the API

evals.prompt: Publish the release notes for v2.0 using what we tracked in Plane releases. Customer-facing.
evals.expected_output: Finds the release with the release tool, reads its work items and existing changelog, groups items into the Release Notes template, publishes a page and stores the notes in the release changelog.
expectations: Finds the release with release(action=list) (and release_tag for the version string) instead of asking the user to list what shipped
Reads the shipped items with release(action=list_workitems, release_id) following next_cursor, and the current changelog with release(action=get_changelog) before overwriting it
Uses the release-notes HTML template, grouped by Highlights, New Features, Improvements, Bug Fixes, Breaking Changes, and omits internal work for a customer audience
Publishes with page(action=create) and stores the notes with release(action=update_changelog, release_id, description_html)
Does not use a create_release_notes or per-operation legacy tool name
